## How it works

<h3>Try it</h3><p>Scroll the table of names, floors and areas, then click a row to highlight its space in the model. The selected row stays highlighted. Click 1 element selected at the top left to open Properties for that space. Pan, zoom and orbit with the viewer's controls.</p>
<h3>Developer integration</h3><p>The public <code>viewer.IfcAPI</code> reads all 269 <code>IfcSpace</code> occurrences from the full clinic architectural model. The table shows their original room numbers and names, containing floors and stored GSA BIM Area quantities, sorted by room number. The area unit is queried from the model and explicit quantity units are honored; missing quantities are shown as Missing. The clinic provides a populated space schedule. BCF visibility exceptions and <code>SpacesVisible</code> reveal all spaces, while BCF selection highlights the clicked GlobalId. Loading and errors use the SDK message API.</p><p>Copy this HTML and serve it over HTTP. The published SDK and unchanged model download require internet access.</p>
<p>The page opens the original source bytes with <code>await viewer.IfcAPI</code>, reads native model data, then closes the model and disposes WASM before displaying the source with <code>viewer.add()</code>. See the <a href="https://thatopen.github.io/engine_web-ifc/docs/classes/web-ifc.IfcAPI.html">complete web-ifc API reference</a>.</p>
